mixture at two atmospheres of pressure.




Clarified rumen fluid (from medium 1310)
Rumen fluid from cow or sheep (obtained from fistulated animals or abattoir refuse) is
filtered through muslin, autoclaved at 121°C for 15 min and then centrifuged at 27,000 g
for 20 min. The supernatant is made anoxic by sparging with 100% N2 gas for 15 min,
dispensed under same gas atmosphere into anoxic serum vials to 30% of volume and then
stored frozen at -20°C.
